name: parkkis
description: Parking in Helsinki is a cognitive minefield. Complex zone rules, resident-only restrictions, and "trap" spots with confusing signage lead to avoidable fines. Drivers need more than just "free spots"—they need to know *safe* spots.

scripts.fetch: cd engine && npx ts-node src/fetch.ts && npx ts-node src/fetch_signs.ts
scripts.ingest: npm run fetch && npm run process
